description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaFrameWriterV1 class, specifically testing the writing of media frames (audio and video) into a shared memory buffer, verifying correct data placement, handling of buffer limits, and multiple frame writing scenarios.

classes.name: RialtoPlayerCommonWriteFrameV1Test
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing MediaFrameWriterV1 frame writing functionality, including setup, teardown, and helper methods for adding frames and verifying buffer contents.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes shared memory info and buffer before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up allocated frames and resets the media frame writer after each test.

methods.name: AddAudioFrame
methods.description: Adds an audio frame with specified parameters to the test data vector.

methods.name: AddVideoFrame
methods.description: Adds a video frame with specified parameters to the test data vector.

methods.name: DeleteFrames
methods.description: Deletes all allocated frame data to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: CheckSharedBuffer
methods.description: Verifies that the shared buffer contains the expected metadata and data for each frame.

methods.name: readLEUint32
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit unsigned integer from a buffer.

methods.name: readLEInt64
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 64-bit signed integer from a buffer.
